name: ppv-fulfillment-monitor
description: Data science web application for PPV fulfillment monitoring and analysis

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && python3 -m uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --reload" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && pip3 install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install
